description:
Sleevy is a read-later bookmark manager that lets you save links from anywhere and read them on any device.

ONE TAP TO SAVE
Tap the share button on any page or link, pick Sleevy, and it lands in your queue. Also available as a Chrome extension, Raycast plugin, web app, MCP and REST API.

EVERY DEVICE IN SYNC
Save on one device, read on another. Your items sync across iPhone, desktop, and the web before you can blink.

SMART ORGANIZATION
Items are automatically categorized by type — articles, videos, repositories, and websites. Add tags and filter by source, tag, or full-text search.

BUILT TO EXTEND
A REST API with personal API keys lets you connect Sleevy to your scripts, shortcuts, and automations. Simple JSON over HTTPS, no SDK required.

KEYBOARD-DRIVEN
The web companion is fully driveable from the keyboard. j/k to navigate, o to open, n to capture, and a fuzzy-find command palette.
keywords: read later,bookmarks,save links,reading list,bookmark manager,sync,articles,read it later,queue
promotionalText: Save links from anywhere, organize them with folders, tags, and filters, and share a folder publicly when you’re ready.
whatsNew: Organize and share your library more easily with improved folder cards, new public profile controls, and polished iPad layouts. We also refined light and dark mode visuals and fixed several small issues.
